mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within the next 3 months triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the subsequent 5 trading days, reflecting reduced labor market confidence and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances show no significant negative relationship (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the unemployment rate does not cross the 4.5% threshold within the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in the federal funds rate and rising quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) creates a synergistic effect, lowering financing costs and amplifying equity valuation growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% AND GDPC1 increases by >2% from prior quarter
failure_condition: The interaction effect's statistical significance (p < 0.05) fails in a 5-year walk-forward test, or the combined signal does not predict returns better than individual proxies.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase marked by elevated industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and housing demand (HOUST > 1300), S&P 500 forward returns exhibit positive momentum over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic activity.
failure_condition: The regime-specific signal fails to predict returns in a 10-year historical sample, or the combination does not outperform a baseline model in regime-conditional testing.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt surge in industrial production (INDPRO > 110) signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns in triggered instances show no statistically significant positive relationship (p > 0.05), or the INDPRO surge does not precede returns by less than 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% and controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL < 250) creates a favorable monetary environment, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction's predictive power (p < 0.05) is not maintained across 3 different monetary regimes, or the combined signal does not correlate with returns in a 5-year historical analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase characterized by rising GDP demand (GDPC1 > 17000) and business investment (RSAFS > 500k), S&P 500 forward returns exhibit positive momentum over the next 60 trading days as economic activity rebounds.
failure_condition: The regime-specific signal fails to predict returns in 80% of post-recession instances, or the interaction effect's t-statistic falls below 2 in a 10-year walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) over the past 12 months signals robust economic growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns in periods of rising GDPC1 show no significant positive relationship (p > 0.05), or the slope of GDPC1 growth does not correlate with returns in a 5-year regression analysis.
